name: v2.5.4 (Oct 10,  2026)
body:
# NumPy 2.5.4 Release Notes

*Released on 2026-10-10.*

NumPy 2.5.4 is a patch release that fixes bugs discovered after the 2.5.3
release. Highlights are:

- Many typing fixes and improvements,
- A workaround for the MSVC 19.51 bug, see below.

This release supports Python versions 3.12-3.15.

## Improvements

- `numpy.linalg.svd` and `numpy.linalg.lstsq` now raise for inputs containing
  infinities instead of returning garbage results.

- Fixed hangs in `numpy.linalg.svd` and `numpy.linalg.lstsq` for certain inputs
  containing infinities for recent versions of some LAPACK implementations.

- `numpy.linalg.cond` now handles non-finite inputs more consistently.

([gh-32593](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32593))

### StringDType hashing with NaN sentinels

`StringDType` instances with equivalent floating-point NaN sentinels now
have equal hashes. Previously, distinct NaN objects could produce equal
dtype instances with different hashes, causing dictionary lookups and set
deduplication to fail.

([gh-32563](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32563))

## Changes

### `MaskedArray` resets a fill_value that cannot be represented in a new dtype

A fill_value copied from a source array is now reset to the default fill_value
for the new dtype when it cannot be represented in that dtype. Previously the
copied value could be stale: ufuncs that change dtype left the result holding a
fill_value typed for the old dtype, which raised a `TypeError` only when
something later validated it (such as `.view()`), and a floating point
fill_value that overflows an integer dtype was kept as an out-of-range value
together with a `RuntimeWarning`. Both now fall back to the default,
including when a masked array is passed to `MaskedArray` with a different
`dtype`. A fill_value given explicitly by the user is still validated and
raises as before. This can now raise a `ComplexWarning` if the fill_value is
complex and the new dtype is real.

([gh-32508](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32508))
([gh-32562](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32562))

## Contributors

A total of 9 people contributed to this release. People with a \"+\" by their
names contributed a patch for the first time.

- Aniket Singh Yadav
- Bhuvansh Kataria +
- Charles Harris
- Iason Krommydas
- Joren Hammudoglu
- Lazizbek Ergashev +
- Nathan Goldbaum
- Sebastian Berg
- Yeonho Kim

## Pull requests merged

A total of 17 pull requests were merged for this release.

- [#32520](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32520): MAINT: Prepare 2.5.x for further development
- [#32557](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32557): BUG: Reset an unrepresentable fill_value on a dtype change (#32508)
- [#32565](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32565): BLD: work around MSVC 19.51 bug (#32561)
- [#32600](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32600): BUG: fix np.strings.replace truncating old/new to a\'s
- [#32707](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32707): BUG: fix [ureduce]{#ureduce} reshape when a kept axis has size 0 (#32536)
- [#32709](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32709): BUG: fix two possible crashes in the ufunc.accumulate implementation\...
- [#32710](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32710): BUG: Reset an inherited fill_value in MaskedArray.\_\_new\_\_ as\...
- [#32711](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32711): ENH: Improvements and fixes for stringdtype hashing (#32563)
- [#32713](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32713): CI: increase ppc64le timeout to match other timeouts (#32583)
- [#32718](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32718): BUG: fix memory leak in legacy ArrayMethod wrapper code
- [#32719](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32719): BUG: check for non-finite input before calling gesdd/gelsd and\...
- [#32738](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32738): BUG: fix segfault in as_arrays() on self-referencing pyscalars
- [#32741](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32741): TYP: Various typing improvements.
- [#32791](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32791): BUG: Fix canonicalization/promotion of nested subarray types\...
- [#32888](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32888): MAINT: Update vendored-meson to match main.
- [#32904](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32904): TYP: Backport a number of typing updates.
- [#32956](https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/32956): TYP: Various typing fixes and improvements.
